sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:43

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:43:1
items.html: His NHY have nothing to rely upon in Atik Yomin, since only the seven of Atik clothed in the seven first ones of AA: That is to say, the true NHY of Atik, that is, the NHY of the Rosh of Atik from its own emanation, which are at the level of Keter, as above in the adjacent item. See there. These NHY do not clothe in AA at all, as above, but only those from the discernment of its Guf, which are of the level of Hochma that is in the HGT of Atik, which are the discernment of the ZAT of Atik, as above. And since this is so, AA itself, which is the discernment of the Keter of Nekudim, is found lacking the NHY of vessels and the GAR of lights, for its GAR are from a degree lower than itself. And since AA is reckoned as the general Keter of Atzilut, and it lacks its own GAR, therefore all the degrees of Atzilut that descend after it are found lacking the NHY of vessels and the GAR of lights; for the GAR of each one of them are the GAR of the degree below it, while its own GAR are lacking to it, as has been explained with AA. And this is his saying, “that all the phases of NHY of any of the Partzufim always come in the secret of an addition and are not essential.” For the Partzuf does not acquire its own NHY except through its joining and its inclusion with the upper one into one Partzuf, as above in the adjacent item, with AA, which becomes one Partzuf with Atik by reason of the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of AVI that it received. And this illumination is reckoned in the secret of an addition and is not essential in the Partzuf, but rather rises and falls, as will be written further along.
